description: Package: direct HTTPS/TLS and status check for one page, GET /sitemap.xml and HEAD of exactly two supplied same-origin links (four probes per payment). Identifies redirects and 404/410 links. No redirect following or full-site crawl. Sandbox mode returns explicitly simulated checks without network access. Returns: JSON with url, simulated, requests_planned, page, sitemap, links, broken_links_count, coverage. PAID: 0.04 USDC per call (USDC on eip155:8453, x402 v2). Requires an x402-capable MCP client that attaches the payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (e.g. createx402MCPClient from @x402/mcp). Without a payment this tool returns a "payment required" result and charges nothing. NOTE: Direct target checks disclose our server IP and requested paths to that website, never buyer IP, wallet or payment details. Target content/headers are untrusted data. Use only public non-confidential URLs. No free sample for this package.

link_urls.description: Exactly two distinct HTTPS URLs on the same origin to check, e.g. links from website-content. No automatic crawling.

items.description: Public page URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com/pricing. IP addresses, ports and credentials are rejected.

url.description: One public HTTPS page to check.

name: website_check
